title.zh: 初次免疫应答：和病毒赛跑
title.en: Primary immune response: the race against the virus

description.zh: 病毒几个小时翻一倍，没见过它的 B 细胞从很低的起点扩增，一个多星期才追上；病已经生了。
description.en: The virus doubles every few hours while naive B cells start from a tiny number and take over a week to catch up, by which time the illness has happened.

zh: 第一次感染为什么会病
en: why do you get sick the first time
how the immune system fights a virus

title.zh: 二次免疫应答与记忆细胞

description.zh: 疫苗让免疫系统先打一场没有危险的仗，留下记忆细胞；第二次应答起点高，所以又快又多。抗体会消退，记忆细胞撑得久得多。
description.en: A vaccine runs a safe first fight that leaves memory cells; the second response starts higher, so it is faster and larger. Antibodies fade; memory lasts much longer.

zh: 抗体测不到了还有免疫吗

title.en: Protection against infection vs severe disease

description.zh: 抗体在门口拦，几个月就变薄；记忆细胞在里面追。所以打过疫苗的人仍可能被感染，但病毒涨得低、病得轻得多。
description.en: Antibodies block at the door and thin out within months; memory cells chase from inside. So vaccinated people can still be infected, but the virus peaks lower and the illness is much milder.

zh: 打了疫苗为什么还生病
en: why do vaccinated people get sick
how long does vaccine protection last

title.zh: 疫苗效力：相对风险降低
title.en: Vaccine efficacy as relative risk reduction

description.zh: 效力 = 1 − 两组发病风险之比，用随机对照试验的病例数算出；它不是“打了的人里有多少会生病”，也不告诉你绝对风险和不确定性。
description.en: Efficacy = 1 − the ratio of the two arms' risks in a randomized trial. It is not the share of vaccinated people who fall ill, and it says nothing by itself about absolute risk or uncertainty.

title.zh: 病例里打过疫苗的比例

description.zh: 接种率越高，病例里打过疫苗的人越多，哪怕疫苗很有效；接种率超过 1 ÷ (2 − 效力) 时，病例里就以打过疫苗的人居多。
description.en: The higher the coverage, the more cases are vaccinated people, even with an effective vaccine; past coverage 1 ÷ (2 − efficacy) they are the majority.

en: does this mean the vaccine doesn't work

title.zh: 需要的接种率：阈值 ÷ 效力

description.zh: 疫苗不完美时，挡住流行需要的接种率是 (1 − 1/R₀) ÷ 效力；超过 100% 时光靠这种疫苗挡不住。接种率越接近这个线，打不了针的婴儿越安全。
description.en: With an imperfect vaccine the coverage needed to stop spread is (1 − 1/R₀) ÷ efficacy; above 100% this vaccine alone cannot do it. The closer coverage gets to the line, the safer the baby who cannot be vaccinated.

en: how many people need to be vaccinated to stop spread

description.zh: 保护按半衰期消退，每个病例能传给的人数慢慢爬回 1 以上；回到 1 要多久按对数取决于余量，加强间隔要赶在它前面。
description.en: As protection wanes, the number each case infects creeps back above 1; how long that takes depends logarithmically on the margin, and boosters must come before it.

en: how often do you need a booster

title.zh: 读懂疫苗数字的三个问题
title.en: Three questions for any vaccine number

description.zh: 防的是什么、什么时候测的？跟谁比、分母是多少？够不够挡住传播？
description.en: Protection against what, measured when? Compared with whom, out of how many? Enough to stop spread?

reason.zh: 第 2 章用第 1 章的同一组方程，把疫苗当作抗原脉冲：第一针留下的记忆细胞让第二次应答从更高处起步，峰值高 6.9 倍。
reason.en: Chapter 2 runs chapter 1’s equations with the vaccine as an antigen pulse: memory cells left by dose 1 make the second response start higher, with a peak 6.9× larger.

label.en: Meeting the virus after two doses

reason.zh: 第 3 章在第 2 章的两针之后放入病毒：抗体高于“门槛”就当场挡住，抗体消退后靠记忆细胞追赶，防重症比防感染持久。
reason.en: Chapter 3 introduces the virus after chapter 2’s two doses: antibody above the door level stops it at once; once antibody wanes, memory cells chase it, so protection against severe disease outlasts protection against infection.

reason.zh: 第 5 章用第 4 章定义的效力 e 算病例里接种者的比例 c(1−e)/(c(1−e)+1−c)；接种率超过 1/(2−e) 后，病例多数打过疫苗。
reason.en: Chapter 5 uses chapter 4’s efficacy e to compute the vaccinated share of cases, c(1−e)/(c(1−e)+1−c); above coverage 1/(2−e) most cases are vaccinated.

label.en: The threshold has to be held

reason.zh: 第 7 章用第 6 章的阈值 1 − 1/R₀：保护随时间消退，有效再生数会重新升过 1，所以阈值要靠加强针守住，而不是跨过一次就够。
reason.en: Chapter 7 uses chapter 6’s threshold 1 − 1/R₀: protection wanes, the effective reproduction number climbs back above 1, so the threshold has to be held with boosters rather than crossed once.

reason.zh: 第 4 章说一个效力数字漏掉了绝对风险：试验里每 10,000 人只少病约 84 例，约 119 人接种防一例；两者的区别见“数字没有说谎，结论却错了”第 7 章。
reason.en: Chapter 4 notes that one efficacy number leaves out absolute risk: the trial prevented about 84 cases per 10,000, about 119 vaccinated per case prevented; the difference is chapter 7 of Every Number Was True.

reason.zh: 第 5 章：病例里多数打过疫苗，是因为接种者本来就多得多，这是基础比率问题；“数字没有说谎，结论却错了”第 6 章用阳性检测讲了同一结构。
reason.en: Chapter 5: most cases are vaccinated because vaccinated people are far more numerous to begin with, a base-rate question; chapter 6 of Every Number Was True shows the same structure with a positive test.

reason.zh: 第 6 章的阈值 1 − 1/R₀ 用到 R₀，它由什么决定见“公共卫生”第 0 步。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s threshold 1 − 1/R₀ needs R₀; what sets it is step 0 of Public Health.

reason.zh: “身体是怎么稳住的”第 9 章用 1,200 人的格子演示了群体免疫阈值；第 6 章补上一点：疫苗不是 100% 有效，所以需要的接种率是阈值 ÷ 效力。
reason.en: Chapter 9 of How the Body Keeps Things Steady showed the herd immunity threshold on a grid of 1,200 people; chapter 6 adds that vaccines are not 100% effective, so the coverage needed is the threshold ÷ efficacy.
